_comment: Single source of truth for circuit version identity (issue #633).
Each circuit has a declared version that is stamped into its compiled
artifact (frontend/public/circuits/<type>.json) by
circuits/scripts/stamp-circuit-version.js, recorded on every credential at
issuance, and checked before proving. Without it a credential carries no
record of which circuit can prove it, so a circuit change that alters the
public-input layout only surfaces as a failed proof.
RULES
- Bump `version` (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH) whenever a change to the circuit can
alter its public-input layout or the constraints it enforces. Bump MAJOR
for a layout change (existing credentials become unprovable), MINOR for
new constraints that keep the layout, PATCH for comment/tooling-only edits.
- Bump `vkVersion` alongside `version`: it is the credential-type VK counter
in CredentialVerifier (monotonic u32 from 1; 0 is reserved as the
'not stored' sentinel). Register the new VK with set_vk(type, vkVersion),
deprecate and prune the old one per SUPPORT_POLICY.md.
- Every circuit listed here is proven and has an on-chain VK. The `commit`
and `commit3` helpers are deliberately absent: they are executed to derive
commitments and never proven, so there is no VK to tie a version to.
- Both fields are also asserted against circuits/testvectors/*.json by
circuits/scripts/testvectors.js, so a circuit edit that forgets to bump
the version fails CI.
